# Write operations

The <kbd>SmemNode</kbd> interface provides several methods for writing data to a node (LanceDB table).

## Add

To add new records to a node, use the <kbd>add()</kbd> method. It automatically generates vector embeddings from the configured vector source column:

```ts
const data = [
    { id: 1, title: "Lorem Ipsum", text: "Lorem ipsum dolor sit amet ...", tags: "science" },
    { id: 2, title: "Quantum Physics", text: "Quantum mechanics describes ...", tags: "physics" },
];
await mem.nodes.documents.add(data);
```

Each record must include the <kbd>vectorSourceCol</kbd> (e.g., `"text"`) which will be embedded into a 384-dimensional vector.

<span class="font-bold txt-warning">Warning</span>: <kbd>add()</kbd> does not check for duplicates. If the data already exists in the database, it will be inserted again. Use <kbd>upsert()</kbd> to insert data without duplicates.

## Upsert

To upsert (update or insert) records, use the <kbd>upsert()</kbd> method. It uses a specified column as the key for matching existing records:

```ts
await mem.nodes.documents.upsert(data, "id");
```

The second parameter is the column name used to match existing records. If a record with that key exists, it is updated; otherwise, it is inserted.

### Upsert Options

The <kbd>upsert()</kbd> method accepts an optional third parameter to control behavior:

```ts
await mem.nodes.documents.upsert(data, "id", true);  // upsert (update + insert)
await mem.nodes.documents.upsert(data, "id", false); // update only
```

## Insert If Not Exists

To insert records only when the key does not already exist:

```ts
await mem.nodes.documents.insertIfNotExists(data, "id");
```

This is useful for seeding data without overwriting existing records.

## Raw Operations

For cases where you already have pre-computed vectors, use the <kbd>addRaw()</kbd> and <kbd>upsertRaw()</kbd> methods. These skip the automatic embedding step:

```ts
// Add with pre-computed vectors
await mem.nodes.documents.addRaw([
    { id: 3, title: "Pre-embedded", text: "Some text", vector: [/* 384 floats */] },
]);

// Upsert with pre-computed vectors
await mem.nodes.documents.upsertRaw(dataWithVectors, "id");
```

## Table Operations

For advanced operations not covered by the methods above, you can access the underlying LanceDB <kbd>Table</kbd> object directly:

### Delete

```ts
await mem.nodes.documents.table.delete("id = 2")
```

### Count

```ts
const nRows = await mem.nodes.documents.table.countRows()
```

Check the <a href="https://lancedb.github.io/lancedb/guides/tables/#deleting-from-a-table">LanceDB table documentation</a> for more information on available table operations.
